「Sorry, but I don't like that sort of thing.」

94:t_018:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ won't run away! Because...!」

94:t_019:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ has effort and guts!」
